title: Apple And Nvidia Interest Tests Intel Foundry Ambitions And Current Valuation
text: Apple and Nvidia are exploring manufacturing partnerships with Intel's foundry business. The talks focus on shifting portions of future chip production to Intel's U.S. based facilities. Both companies have historically relied on foundries such as TSMC and Samsung for chip manufacturing. The potential deals would validate Intel's foundry model and could influence global chip supply arrangements.
